chapters.reason: The paper focuses on sentence embeddings, which are primarily derived from shallow/early layer representations that capture syntactic and semantic features for downstream tasks.
The approach uses mutual information and alignment of attention patterns across augmented views, which relates to how information is structured and transmitted within the model.
The contrastive learning framework acts as a distillation process to refine the latent representations, which is a core function of intermediate layers in the context of embedding quality.
